scope: Electron frontend startup with an unavailable external font stylesheet

before.interpretation: Original production frontend stayed behind its startup gate while Google Fonts CSS was held; became ready after the held request was aborted.

after.qualification: Same Electron main with a separately served production frontend containing the uncommitted font change. A reload control, not the final 100-cycle native fault matrix.
after.fontChecks: Normal Cyrillic, italic Cyrillic and display font load checks were made on the first navigation before the measured reload.
